clue.text: Amount added to, bill for small tree

parts.note: an amount or total is a sum
AC, short for account, is a bill

explanation.surface: A sum added to a bill to pay for a small tree from a nursery.
explanation.definitionFit: The sumac is a shrub or little ornamental tree with bright autumn foliage.

clue.text: One can't carry on a case single-handed

definitions.text: One can't carry on a case single-handed

parts.words: One can't carry on a case single-handed
parts.note: sounds like a lawyer unable to manage a court case alone, but the case is a patient carried on a litter by two people

explanation.surface: A lawyer who cannot handle a lawsuit alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A person carrying an injured patient on a litter needs a partner at the other end.

clue.text: State with ocean to the East

parts.note: the main is the open sea

explanation.surface: A state that has the ocean on its eastern side.
explanation.definitionFit: Maine is a US state on the Atlantic coast of New England.

clue.text: Half-hearted banter producing irritation

indicators.note: half-hearted says the doubled letters at the centre of the word lose one of their pair

parts.note: chaffing is teasing banter

explanation.surface: Lukewarm teasing that ends up causing annoyance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half-hearted' drops one of the two Fs at the heart of CHAFFING.
explanation.definitionFit: Chafing is soreness from rubbing, a physical irritation of the skin.

clue.text: He likes to take people for a ride with the pack

definitions.text: He likes to take people for a ride with the pack

parts.words: He likes to take people for a ride with the pack
parts.note: reads like a driver or tour guide, but 'take for a ride' means cheat and 'the pack' is a pack of playing cards

explanation.surface: A man who enjoys driving a group of people around.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheat at card games swindles fellow players using sleight of hand with the deck.

clue.text: Cooked potato with cold joint

parts.note: C is short for cold, as on a tap
the hip is a joint

explanation.surface: A cooked potato served with a cold joint of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A chip is a strip of fried potato, what Americans call a French fry.

clue.text: How he turns nasty to take over the business

indicators.note: nasty suggests something turned bad, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: This is how a man turns unpleasant in order to seize control of a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in charge and control everything is the idiom for managing an operation.

clue.text: Delivered milk directly to consumer

parts.note: reads like a milkman's doorstep round, but describes a mother feeding her baby at the breast

explanation.surface: A dairy sent milk straight to the customer.
explanation.definitionFit: A mother or animal nursing young gives them milk from the breast or teat.

clue.text: Books that had to be kept away from the Canon

definitions.text: Books that had to be kept away from the Canon

parts.words: Books that had to be kept away from the Canon
parts.note: suggests reading banned from a clergyman, but means scriptures excluded from the accepted Bible

explanation.surface: Volumes that had to be hidden from a cathedral clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: These biblical writings were excluded from the accepted body of scripture.

clue.text: Painter they call eccentric, by way of explanation

indicators.note: eccentric means off-centre or odd, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An artist people call odd, as an aside.
explanation.definitionFit: A remark made in brackets is an aside, added as a passing clarification.

clue.text: Dreadful state of sport associated with island race

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a sport
a nation is a race or people

explanation.surface: A sport linked with an island people has fallen into a dreadful state.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruination is a condition of complete wreck or downfall.

clue.text: Many papers reported this singing group

indicators.note: reported means the word is heard spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Many newspapers have covered this singing group.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir is a body of singers, often in a church.

clue.text: Unproved statement in article relative abridged

parts.note: THE is the definite article

indicators.note: abridged means shortened, so the relative word loses its ending

parts.note: a sister is a relative

explanation.surface: An unproven claim appears in a shortened article about a relative.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abridged' cuts TER from SISTER, leaving SIS.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesis is a proposition put forward to be argued and not yet proved.

clue.text: Issue so-called frozen bird

indicators.note: so-called signals that the words are as spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: frozen means chilled and a wren is a bird, said together

explanation.surface: Something described as a frozen bird is being issued.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue in the legal sense means offspring, a person's sons and daughters.

clue.text: One who is conscious of his fantasies?

definitions.text: One who is conscious of his fantasies?

parts.words: One who is conscious of his fantasies
parts.note: sounds like self-awareness, but means someone who has fantasies while awake rather than asleep

explanation.surface: A self-aware person who knows about their fantasies.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lost in reverie has waking dreams, imagining things while conscious.

clue.text: Sort of figures' it takes a certain time to run through

definitions.meaning: a shapely female figure with a narrow waist is described this way

definitions.text: it takes a certain time to run through
definitions.meaning: a timer through which sand runs in a fixed period

explanation.definitionFit: The sand timer pinched in the middle gives its name to a narrow-waisted figure.

clue.text: Endlessly draw attention to good servant

indicators.note: endlessly means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: to underline something is to emphasise it

explanation.surface: Keep pointing out a good servant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' cuts the last E from UNDERLINE.
explanation.definitionFit: An underling is a subordinate who serves those above.

clue.text: Difficulty one can get out of when swimming

definitions.text: Difficulty one can get out of when swimming

parts.words: Difficulty one can get out of when swimming
parts.note: sounds like escaping trouble, but plays on being 'out of one's' something in water too deep to stand

explanation.surface: A problem a swimmer manages to escape from.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep water where a swimmer cannot touch bottom is the idiom for being beyond one's ability.

clue.text: More than one spoke these lines

definitions.text: More than one spoke these lines

parts.words: More than one spoke these lines
parts.note: reads as several people speaking lines in a play, but means several wheel spokes, which are lines from a centre

explanation.surface: Several actors delivered these lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines from the centre of a circle to its edge, like wheel spokes, are its radial lines in the plural.

clue.text: Complaint I will put to head

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I will
a ness is a headland

explanation.surface: Someone vows to take a grievance to the boss.
explanation.walkthrough: A ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness's neighbours Dungeness and Sheerness.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint in the medical sense is an ailment.

clue.text: Suppressor that prevents humming?

parts.note: sounds like an electrical suppressor stopping a hum, but humming is slang for smelling bad

explanation.surface: An electronic device that stops a buzzing noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A product applied to the skin masks body odour, which British slang calls humming.

clue.text: Sort of illusion measure of drink over a litre can produce

parts.note: an optic is a pub dispenser giving a fixed measure of spirits

explanation.surface: A tot poured on top of a litre can make you see things.
explanation.walkthrough: An Optic is the British pub device fixed to an upturned spirit bottle that pours a set measure; 'over' puts it above A and L in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A visual trick that deceives the eye is the classic kind of illusion.

clue.text: English left back excelled and signed on

indicators.note: back says this word is read in reverse

parts.note: lorn means left alone, forsaken
led means came first, excelled

explanation.surface: An English left back played brilliantly and then signed for the club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LORN into NROL. 'left back' looks like a football position, but it is a synonym plus a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrol is to register or join up formally.

clue.text: Still not well-received because of this?

explanation.definitionFit: The word means motionless and also names atmospheric interference on a radio.

clue.text: Use coach to prepare for sport

definitions.meaning: travel by rail, a coach being a railway carriage
to practise or get fit for a contest

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to travel by rail and to practise for an athletic event.

clue.text: Drug addict's attendant, not hard-hearted

indicators.note: hard gives H, and its absence from the heart of the word means removing it from the middle

parts.note: an usher is an attendant

explanation.surface: A drug addict's carer, who is not unfeeling.
explanation.walkthrough: H for hard is removed from the heart of USHER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who takes drugs habitually is a user in slang.

clue.text: Gather together for hike

definitions.meaning: to muster, as in collecting an army or funds
an increase, as in a pay rise

explanation.definitionFit: One can muster troops or money this way, and it also means an increase in pay.

clue.text: Variety from US I challenge, in part

indicators.note: in part says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A variety show coming from America that someone means to challenge.
explanation.definitionFit: Variety is the theatre entertainment of songs, comedy and acts, which Britain called music hall.

clue.text: One who keeps records for a doctor

definitions.meaning: an official who records births, marriages and deaths
a senior hospital doctor grade in Britain, below consultant

explanation.definitionFit: The title names both an official keeper of records and a British hospital doctor in training.

clue.text: Name duly made up for lord in tale

indicators.note: made up means invented or put together, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A name duly invented for a lord in a story.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord Lundy is the subject of one of Hilaire Belloc's Cautionary Tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Belloc's comic verse tells of Lord Lundy, a nobleman too freely prone to weep.
